evals.prompt: Write the design doc for moving session storage from Redis to Postgres. Facts: Redis bill is $1,400/month, sessions are 2GB, we already run Postgres 16 for everything else, p99 read must stay under 20ms, I haven't decided the TTL sweep interval. Alternatives I looked at: keep Redis, use Cloudflare KV.
evals.expected_output: A design doc in the templates.md skeleton: Context, Decision, Why this over the alternatives (Redis and KV each with the reason it lost), Consequences, Input wanted naming the TTL sweep interval. No Background or Timeline section, no invented latency or cost figures beyond the ones given.
assertions: Uses only the supplied numbers and invents no latency, cost, or date
Names both alternatives with a one-sentence reason each
Input wanted line names the TTL sweep interval and nothing vaguer
Contains no section without a supplied fact under it
Leaves the TTL decision open rather than choosing one
